title: ophrys lutea subsp. minor
intro: Ophrys lutea subsp. minor, commonly known as the lesser yellow bee orchid, is a type of orchid native to the Iberian Peninsula and the Pyrenees. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys lutea subsp. minor include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, modulate the immune system, and exhibit analgesic and anti-hemorrhagic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
